stories.headline: Claude Helped a Hacker Find a Way to Issue Tickets to Almost Every US Music Festival
stories.dek: A researcher found that using Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7, he could break into the website of Front Gate—used by every festival from Lollapalooza to Bonnaroo—and freely issue any ticket he chose.

stories.headline: Cloudflare’s new policy pushes AI companies to pay for publishers’ content
stories.dek: Cloudflare is giving AI companies until September 15 to separate web crawlers used for search from those used for AI training and agents, or risk being blocked by default on many publisher sites.
